observations: Multiple pressing irons of various colors and designs are displayed on a wooden surface.
The irons are arranged in rows, suggesting a retail or wholesale setting.
The background shows a metal door and a corrugated metal wall, typical of a shop or warehouse.
No brand names, logos, or model numbers are legible on the irons in the photo.
The irons appear to be in good cosmetic condition, but internal condition and power ratings are not visible.

claims.evidence: The photo shows the irons from a distance; internal cleanliness and the condition of the soleplate cannot be confirmed.
Origin cannot be determined from a photo of the exterior.
The photo does not show any UK import markings or documentation.

risks.risk: The irons may be generic or third-party brands rather than well-known imported brands.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the brand logo and model number on the side or base of an iron.

risks.risk: The heating elements or steam mechanisms may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the irons powered on, heating up, and producing steam.

risks.risk: The soleplates may be scratched, burnt, or have damaged non-stick coatings.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the soleplate of each iron.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having a damaged soleplate

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the irons plugged in and heating up.
Close-up photos of the soleplates to check for scratches or damage.
Photo of the power rating (wattage) on the base of the irons.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
